integrity: Analytic proof and standalone exact-rational checker included; finite computations are checks, not substitutes for infinite proofs. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Results concern first returns of the induced Markov map to a specified natural three-cell base, not physical-time returns of the original bimodal system. The full quantitative result has not been independently audited; comprehensive publication priority across specialized skip-free renewal literature is unconfirmed.
title: Exact first returns and critical crossover for a Fibonacci bimodal Markov map
